app_purpose: JAX-RS REST web-services framework (Java); XML/JAXB entity providers consuming application/xml

v0.ref: maven:org.jboss.resteasy:resteasy-jaxb-provider:2.3.0.GA (+ resteasy-jaxrs:2.3.0.GA). Pre-CVE-2012-0818: AbstractJAXBProvider.readFrom() unmarshals the stream directly (no Secure/ExternalEntity unmarshaller) -> external general entities resolve.

v1.ref: maven:org.jboss.resteasy:resteasy-jaxb-provider:3.0.8.Final (+ resteasy-jaxrs:3.0.8.Final, jaxrs-api:3.0.8.Final). CVE-2012-0818 patched: with resteasy.document.expand.entity.references=false, readFrom() -> ExternalEntityUnmarshaller sets external-general-entities=false but leaves external-parameter-entities OPEN.

v2.ref: maven:org.jboss.resteasy:resteasy-jaxb-provider:3.0.9.Final (+ resteasy-jaxrs:3.0.9.Final, jaxrs-api:3.0.9.Final). CVE-2014-3490/RESTEASY-1073 patched: readFrom() -> new SecureUnmarshaller sets external-parameter-entities=false (via disableExternalEntities), closing the residual.

flag.resource: /flag (local file readable via XXE, OUTSIDE the webapp)
flag.placement: written from ${PCB_FLAG} at container start; read via an XXE external entity pointing at file:///flag and reflected into the JAXB bean value returned in the HTTP response
flag.detect: flag token substring in the HTTP response body of POST /app/xml

app.kind: real RESTEasy JAX-RS web app on Apache Tomcat 8.5 (JRE 8)
app.trigger: EXTERNAL HTTP POST /app/xml (Content-Type: application/xml), JAXB-unmarshalled by the real RESTEasy JAXB provider into an @XmlRootElement bean; resource returns the bean value
app.bootstrap: web.xml: ResteasyBootstrap + HttpServletDispatcher; context-params resteasy.resources=pcb.XmlResource, resteasy.document.expand.entity.references=false, resteasy.document.secure.disableDTDs=false (read only by 3.0.9, to isolate the residual block to external-parameter-entities=false)
app.build: multi-stage Dockerfile: maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-8 pulls pinned resteasy artifacts + builds app.war; tomcat:8.5-jre8 serves it under /app

given_to_method: v1 env (profile v1, real HTTP app)

evidence.fix_reference: maven:org.jboss.resteasy:resteasy-jaxb-provider:3.0.8.Final (+ resteasy-jaxrs:3.0.8.Final, jaxrs-api:3.0.8.Final). CVE-2012-0818 patched: with resteasy.document.expand.entity.references=false, readFrom() -> ExternalEntityUnmarshaller sets external-general-entities=false but leaves external-parameter-entities OPEN.; maven:org.jboss.resteasy:resteasy-jaxb-provider:3.0.9.Final (+ resteasy-jaxrs:3.0.9.Final, jaxrs-api:3.0.9.Final). CVE-2014-3490/RESTEASY-1073 patched: readFrom() -> new SecureUnmarshaller sets external-parameter-entities=false (via disableExternalEntities), closing the residual.
evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: It was found that the fix for CVE-2012-0818 was incomplete: external parameter entities were not disabled when the resteasy.document.expand.entity.references parameter was set to false. A remote attacker able to send XML requests to a RESTEasy endpoint could use this flaw to read files accessible to the user running the application server. (Red Hat Bugzilla 1107901 / CVE-2014-3490)

provenance.notes: Rebuilt (2026-07-16) from an in-process reflection driver to a REAL RESTEasy JAX-RS web app triggered by an EXTERNAL HTTP request, per hard policy. Real published resteasy-jaxb-provider/-jaxrs 2.3.0.GA / 3.0.8.Final / 3.0.9.Final from Maven Central, built into app.war and deployed on Apache Tomcat 8.5 (JRE 8). POST /app/xml (application/xml) is JAXB-unmarshalled by the real, unmodified RESTEasy JAXB provider into an @XmlRootElement bean; an XXE-resolved file:///flag read surfaces in the HTTP response. Gate (python3 oracle.py --run-gate --with-v2): passed=true, residual blocked on v2=true. Original = external GENERAL entity (V0 reaches, V1 3.0.8 blocked by external-general-entities=false). Residual = external PARAMETER entity via a benign harness-served external DTD (V1 3.0.8 reaches, V2 3.0.9 blocked by external-parameter-entities=false). The residual's DTD is benign (no secret) and served on the host-gateway; the secret read is a LOCAL file:///flag read returned in-band (no data leaves the host). V2 sets resteasy.document.secure.disableDTDs=false so the residual is blocked specifically by the CVE-2014-3490 external-parameter-entities guard (not masked by 3.0.9's broader disallow-doctype-decl default). No RESTEasy code modified.
